metadata.author: Oracle Ninja Press
metadata.description: Forty large, simple garden pictures to colour, drawn with thick unbroken lines and wide open spaces. Every picture is printed on its own page and backed by a blank one, so felt pens and markers cannot show through onto the next drawing. The outlines are solid and closed all the way round, so colour stays where you put it. Shapes are big and uncomplicated, with no small corners to work into, which makes them comfortable if your eyes are tired or your hands are not steady. Printed single-sided on bright white paper at 8.5 by 11 inches for high contrast.
metadata.subtitle: 40 Large-Print Coloring Pages with Thick, Unbroken Lines
metadata.title: Big Bold Garden

prompt_plan.house_style: Bold-and-easy line art for low-vision and limited-dexterity colourists. Solid black outline of uniform weight on pure white, every stroke unbroken so no fill can escape. Large simple shapes with generous open interiors; no region smaller than a fingertip. No shading, no hatching, no texture, no background.

research.opportunity: The two most repeated complaints in this category, bleed-through and lines that do not close, are both mechanically verifiable rather than matters of taste. A book that can demonstrate it has neither, aimed at low-vision and limited-dexterity colourists, competes on the exact axis buyers complain about.
research.segment: large-print bold-line colouring for low-vision and limited-dexterity adults

observations: the bold-and-easy style is repeatedly described as growing faster than the titles serving it
buyers named are seniors, beginners, and people who find intricate adult designs overwhelming
forty designs printed single-sided is the common shape, giving about eighty interior pages
high contrast and thick outlines are described as the functional requirement, not a style preference
arthritis, tremor and reduced hand strength are named as distinct buyer needs alongside low vision
memory care and assisted living are named as institutional buying contexts
large open areas matter as much as line weight: small regions are unusable with a shaky hand
printing on both sides, causing marker bleed-through, is the most consistently repeated complaint
lines that do not meet, so fills leak across the page, is the second repeated complaint
inconsistency between pages within one book is a third recurring theme
some publishers print a note on reverse pages explaining the blank is deliberate
signals.segment: colouring buyer complaints across the category

observations: the observed asking range for bold-and-easy senior titles runs roughly nine to thirteen dollars
the wider colouring category clusters lower, around eight to ten dollars
signals.segment: pricing observed in the bold-and-easy band

strategy.concept: Forty large, simple garden and household subjects drawn with thick unbroken outlines and wide open areas, printed one to a page on white stock so that nothing shows through and every region can be filled without precision.
differentiators: every drawing is printed single-sided and backed by a blank page
outlines are verified closed by pixel inspection, so a fill cannot leak
stroke weight is held above 2.5pt so the line stays visible at arm's length
no region is smaller than a fingertip, so a shaky hand can still fill it
high-contrast black on white stock rather than cream, which lowers contrast
printed with no bleed, which buys a wider margin than a bleed layout allows
strategy.purpose: usable colouring for people whose eyes or hands make ordinary adult colouring books unrewarding
risks: the bold-and-easy segment is growing quickly and is attracting volume publishers
accessibility claims invite scrutiny; every one made on the cover must be true of the file
8.5x11 is large trim, so printing costs 2.84 a copy and pricing below 9.99 leaves very little
institutional buyers may want larger print runs than a single title supports
subtitle_concepts: 40 Large-Print Coloring Pages with Thick, Unbroken Lines
strategy.unique_angle: The two failures buyers complain about most in this category, bleed-through and outlines with gaps in them, are both checked mechanically before the book is built rather than hoped for: single-sided layout is enforced by the specification gate, and every page is measured for enclosed regions.
strategy.visual_direction: thick unbroken black outlines on white, large simple shapes, generous open interiors, no shading, no texture, no small detail
